logical_cursor: exact source coordinate or immutable unit-span identity
proposed_reading: exact proposed source reading; do not patch German

evidence.coordinate: stable path or URL plus page/crop coordinates

alternatives_considered: alternative reading and why it remains possible or was rejected

independent_checker.identity: checker/task identity distinct from initial observer

notes: A translator's guess is not a source defect. Coordinate debt is a tooling record, not a source-defect claim.
